help.label: Our hypothesis, not their claim. Built from public pages only; nothing of theirs was tested.
help.pitch: RiskMandate would measure, for one real deployment of Ethiack's agents, what each agent was asked to do (its mandate), what its credentials and connections actually let it reach (its grant), and the difference between the two (the gap), and keep that as a written record. It is read-only: never in the request path.
